title: Window Function
text: Compute and apply window to input signal, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Operation} sets the modes of operation Apply window, {Window type} sets the type of window, {Sampling} sets the type of sampling, {Sample mode}, {Sample time}, {Window length} sets the length of window, {Stopband attenuation in dB}, {Beta} sets the kaiser window β parameter, {Number of sidelobes}, {Maximum sidelobe level relative to mainlobe (dB)}, {Window function name}, {Specify additional arguments to the hamming function} sets the additional arguments to the window, {Cell array of additional arguments} sets the additional arguments, {Window data type}, {Signed} sets the window output is signed, {Word length}, {User-defined data type (e.g. sfix(16), float(’single))} sets the user-defined data type sfix, {Set fraction length in output to} sets the scaling of fixed-point window data type Best, {Fraction length} sets the user-defined fraction length, {Overflow mode}, {Window}, {Product output}, {Output} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signal vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Operation
params.values: Modes of operation Apply window to input (default) | Generate window | Generate and apply window

params.name: Window type
params.values: Type of window Hamming (default) | Bartlett | Blackman |...

params.name: Sampling
params.values: Type of sampling Symmetric (default) | Periodic

params.name: Sample mode
params.values: Sample mode Continuous (default) | Discrete

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time 1 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Window length
params.values: Length of window 64 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Stopband attenuation in dB
params.values: Stopband attenuation in dB 50 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Beta
params.values: Kaiser window β parameter 10 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Number of sidelobes
params.values: Number of sidelobes 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum sidelobe level relative to mainlobe (dB)
params.values: Maximum sidelobe level relative to mainlobe -30 (default) | scalar less than or equal to zero

params.name: Window function name
params.values: Window function name hamming (default) | character vector

params.name: Specify additional arguments to the hamming function
params.values: Specify additional arguments to the window function off (default) | on

params.name: Cell array of additional arguments
params.values: Additional arguments {’symmetric’} (default) | cell array

params.name: Window data type
params.values: Window data type double (default) | single | Fixed-point | User-defined | Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Signed
params.values: Window output is signed on (default) | off

params.name: Word length
params.values: Word length 16 (default) | positive integer in the range [2 128]

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: User-defined fraction length 15 (default) | integer

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Overflow mode
params.values: Overflow mode Wrap (default) | Saturate

params.name: Window
params.values: Window data type Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length | Binary point scaling | Slope and bias scaling
